title: Genesis 22:1-2 — The Akedah, the Binding of Isaac (God tests Abraham)
summary: Title and opening verses of the Akedah: Genesis 22:1-2 in English, in which God tests Abraham, Abraham answers “Here am I,” and God tells him to take his only son Isaac to the land of Moriah to offer him as a burnt offering. “Love” is drawn with a heart and a superscript 1. (Identical to the previous slide.)

text.text: 1 Now it came about after these things, that God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” And he said, “Here am I.”
2 He said, “Take now your son, your only son, whom you lo♥e¹, Isaac, and go to the land of Moriah, and offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains of which I will tell you.”

numbers.note: superscript on “love” — first mention of love in the Bible

uncertain: The superscript 1 after “love” is not explained on the slide; it most likely marks the first occurrence of “love” in the Bible.
